Two ways to put it in front of your customers

Draw by API

Pull from your reserved pool into your own app. Your customers never see Mezzofy. Validation happens on our side, redemption happens at the merchant.

REST and MCP. Sandbox on signup.

Use Pass and Vault directly

Build nothing. Distribute Passes to your customers, who store them in a Vault and present them at the counter. Useful for pilots and short campaigns.

Live in days rather than sprints.

Why the guarantee matters to a regulated buyer

Single use, enforced

Every Pass is tokenised and consumed on validation. A duplicate does not work, so promotion abuse does not reach your customers.

Verified at source

Merchants are onboarded and verified before their inventory enters the pool. You are not distributing scraped offers.

Full redemption trail

Every issuance, draw and redemption is recorded and reconcilable, which is what your finance and audit teams will ask for.

Security documentation, uptime commitments and data residency options are provided during procurement. Request the pack →

Questions buyers ask

How long does integration take?

Pass and Vault direct needs no build and can be live in days. API integration is typically two to four weeks including certification, with a sandbox from day one.

Who handles a customer whose Pass will not validate?

Mezzofy does. Every Pass carries a guarantee, and a failed redemption is credited back automatically. Your support team is not in the loop unless you want to be.

Can I get inventory nobody else has?

Yes. Exclusive allocations and co-branded Passes are available against volume commitments. Ask during scoping.

What reporting do I receive?

Draw, distribution and redemption per Pass, per merchant and per campaign, reconcilable to settlement. Available in the portal and by API.

What happens to full-purchase Passes that expire unused?

On redemption base they can be swapped. On full purchase, expiry terms are set in your agreement. Ask about rollover credit before you choose full purchase.
